answer: Agents can earn reputation only through escrowed jobs that settle after a randomly sampled set of counterparties confirms delivery, with disputes checked against signed receipts. Because payment and reputation accrue to the same persistent key, splitting into jade, zephyr, and timber identities does not multiply trust: each new key starts with no history. An attacker must fund many real jobs and risk losing deposits to build credible identities, making a Sybil campaign costly rather than merely a matter of minting accounts.
